about: Where PlayTrickster differs from the wiki's skill pages (data/builds.json). Each entry replaces those fields of the skill in every job that has it. Fields: items [{ name, qty }], tm, master, learn, needs [{ name, lv }], how { kind, text }. 'checked' says who checked what, and when.
